name: Single-phase bridge rectifier
summary: A single-phase bridge rectifier converts its specified AC input to a DC output through a bridge arrangement.
description: A single-phase bridge rectifier converts its specified AC input to a DC output through a bridge arrangement. The schematic must distinguish both AC terminals from the positive and negative output terminals.
readingNotes: Preserve DC polarity when moving or rotating the functional block.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A bridge rectifier is an AC-to-DC stage, not a complete regulated DC power supply.
